subject: Okta contract repricing + device posture amendment
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@okta.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Updated renewal proposal + device posture add-on

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the heads up on your upcoming renewal. Attached is our baseline renewal quote (Redwood_Okta_Quote_v2.pdf) covering SSO/MFA licenses for the next 12 months, and an optional line item for Device Posture enforcement (agent + posture policies). The posture add-on is quoted as a % uplift to your seat cost — details in page 3.

A few quick notes:
- We can hold pricing through 2025-12-15.
- If you bundle posture + support retainer we can offer a one-time onboarding credit.
- For device posture at scale we recommend the posture collector (lightweight agent) and an API integration with your MDM; I included a short integration checklist in the attachment.

Can you confirm current seat counts and whether you want posture scoped to managed devices only? Happy to set up a short call if helpful.

Attachments: Redwood_Okta_Quote_v2.pdf; Integration_Checklist.txt

Best,
Samir
Okta — Enterprise Renewals
samir.patel@okta.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0132

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@okta.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-16T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated renewal proposal + device posture add-on

Samir —

Thanks for the quote. A couple of clarifying items before we circulate internally:

1) Seat counts: we have 1,250 active seats for product + 200 contractors (contractor seats are billed differently last cycle). Quote should reflect both categories separately.
2) Device posture: yes, we want posture to apply to both managed and unmanaged devices, but with stricter policies for unmanaged (browser token + posture check). Can you confirm technical limitations?
3) Term/discount: given we are considering a 9-month extension to align with our budget calendar, can you provide an option for a 9-month term and one for 12 months, with corresponding discounts?

Vivek — could you flag any security prerequisites we should require (SOC 2 addendum, data handling for posture telemetry)? Rishi — I’ll need procurement help on negotiating the PO terms.

If useful, we can do a 30m sync next week — I’m available Tue/Wed morning.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@okta.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Okta Renewals <renewals@okta.com>
Date: 2025-11-20T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated renewal proposal + device posture add-on

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the details. Per your requests I’ve attached an updated quote (Redwood_Okta_Quote_v3.pdf) that:
- Separates contractor seats (line item B).
- Includes two term rows: 9-month and 12-month pricing.
- Adds posture for managed + unmanaged devices; unmanaged has a slightly higher per-seat uplift.

We can offer a 12% net discount on the 12-month term if you take the posture add-on and sign by 2025-12-10. If you sign for 9 months we can do 9% net.

For posture telemetry: we only collect device posture metadata (device id, posture state, timestamps). We do not collect full disk or application-level logs unless you enable additional telemetry. I’ve attached a one-page posture configuration summary.

Quoted attachments: Redwood_Okta_Quote_v3.pdf; DevicePosture_Configuration_Summary.xlsx

Let me know if you want me to include a line for a managed onboarding retainer — we can credit that back if you commit to the posture product.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-28T08:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated renewal proposal + device posture add-on

Team —

Reviewed Samir's v3. A few suggested negotiation levers before we respond:
- Target: 20% off list on the 12-month bundle (posture + seats). If they insist on 12% we should ask for onboarding credit + extended tech support hours.
- Term alignment: 9-month allows us to re-run vendor tender in Q3 2026; prefer 9-month with a stronger discount if Okta can commit to migration assistance.
- Security: require a posture telemetry processing addendum (Vivek, can you draft language that limits telemetry retention to 30 days and requires access controls?).

Action items: Rishi, please draft a short counter that requests 20%/9-month option + PO milestone payment schedule (50% on sign, 50% on Go-Live). Marissa, hold the DocuSign until we see their final concession.

Short replies:
Rishi Malhotra: "I can push 25% if they include a 60-day onboarding credit."
Vivek Kulkarni: "Will draft the telemetry addendum; need vendor SOC2 Type II report and evidence of encryption at rest for posture datastore."

-Lauren
VP, IT Procurement
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@okta.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Okta Renewals <renewals@okta.com>
Date: 2025-12-02T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated renewal proposal + device posture add-on

Marissa —

Thanks for the internal review and the clearly stated asks. Per our internal approvals we can do the following concessions:

- 18% off the 12-month posture bundle (finalized in Redwood_Okta_Quote_v3.pdf, highlighted).
- 9-month term option at 10% off.
- Onboarding credit: $18,000 applied to first invoice if you sign the posture bundle.
- DocuSign contract is ready: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC123 (I attached the signed-amendment-draft.docx for your review).
- For telemetry: I’ve attached our SOC 2 Type II attestation and confirm posture datastore encryption at rest; we are willing to sign a 30-day retention addendum with a commercial confidentiality clause.

Next steps:
1) Confirm which term (9m/12m) you prefer and the final seat split.
2) Provide PO number for procurement (we can accept a PO to trigger the DocuSign envelope).

If you’d like, I can join a short call with Rishi and Lauren to finalize payment milestones this week.

Best,
Samir
Okta — Enterprise Renewals
